APNI has been in discussions with global automotive producers, such as Tesla and Mercedes-Benz, to ensure that Indonesian nickel meets international ESG standards.

body: PT Bumi Konawe Minerina, a subsidiary of Aquila Nickel Group, has implemented a Regulatory Compliance System (RCS) to enhance legal compliance and governance in the nickel mining industry. The system aims to ensure timely and structured management of legal obligations, supporting the company's commitment to responsible and transparent mining practices.

title: Indonesian Nickel Industry Leaders Discuss Challenges and Strategies for Resilience
body: Indonesian nickel industry leaders discussed the challenges of low nickel prices, global uncertainty, and the importance of sustainable investment at the 4th Nickel Producers, Processors, and Buyers Conference in Jakarta. They emphasized the need for realistic market expectations, diversification of products and markets, and responsible mining practices to ensure the long-term sustainability of the industry.

title: SESNA Develops Renewable Energy Solutions for Nickel Smelters in Indonesia
body: PT Sumber Energi Surya Nusantara (SESNA) is building a 300 MWp solar power plant to support decarbonization of nickel smelters in Indonesia, particularly in the Morowali industrial area. The project aims to reduce carbon emissions and meet global sustainability standards, with a target to start construction in September 2025.

title: Indonesia's Mining Sector Contributes Rp74.2 Trillion to State Revenue in H1 2025
body: Indonesia's mining sector, led by nickel, contributed Rp74.2 trillion to state revenue in the first half of 2025, with the sector's overall revenue reaching Rp138.8 trillion, or 54.5% of the annual target. The government is optimistic that the target of Rp254.5 trillion can be achieved by the end of the year, driven by stable commodity prices and increased national production volume.

title: Indonesia's Energy and Mineral Sector Sees 24.1% Investment Growth in Semester I 2025
body: Indonesia's energy and mineral sector has seen a significant 24.1% growth in investment in Semester I 2025, reaching US$13.9 billion, with the oil and gas subsector contributing the most at US$8.1 billion. The sector has also created 753,578 jobs and generated Rp138.8 trillion in non-tax state revenue, despite declining global commodity prices.

title: Pertamina NRE Boosts Renewable Energy Capacity, Sees 14% Increase in 1H 2025
body: Pertamina New & Renewable Energy (Pertamina NRE) has increased its renewable energy capacity by 14% to 2,842 MW in the first half of 2025, driven by its strategic acquisition of a 20% stake in Filipino energy company Citicore Renewable Energy Corporation (CREC). CREC's revenue grew 28% to ₱2.66 billion, with EBITDA rising 22% to ₱932 million and net profit jumping 38% to ₱630 million.

title: Pertamina NRE's Investment in CREC Boosts Stock Price by 30%
body: Pertamina NRE's investment in CREC on June 18 was positively received by the Philippine stock market, with CREC's stock price increasing by 30% to ₱4.21 (around Rp 1,195 per share) since the start of 2025. The investment has led to a significant surge in CREC's stock value, reflecting market confidence in the partnership.

title: Zulfan Zahar Elected as New Chairman of Masyarakat Energi Terbarukan Indonesia (METI)
body: Zulfan Zahar has been elected as the new Chairman of Masyarakat Energi Terbarukan Indonesia (METI) for the 2025-2028 period, securing 84.9% of the votes. The new leadership is expected to focus on developing human resources and promoting transparency in the renewable energy sector to support Indonesia's national energy transition goals.

title: METI Holds National Congress, Elects New Leader to Accelerate Renewable Energy Transition
body: The Indonesian Renewable Energy Society (METI) held its 9th National Congress, where three candidates, Norman Ginting, Suroso Isnandar, and Zulfan Zahar, are vying for the position of General Chairperson to lead the organization towards a green economy and decarbonization. The new leader is expected to bring fresh momentum to accelerate Indonesia's renewable energy transition.

title: Indonesia's Electric Vehicle Industry Enters New Phase, Emphasizing Battery Safety and Certification
body: PT CARSURIN Tbk, a leading battery testing laboratory operator in Indonesia, warns the electric vehicle industry to prioritize battery safety and certification, citing the decline in electric motorcycle sales after subsidy quotas ended in 2024. The company emphasizes that investing in battery testing is crucial for long-term growth and reputation, rather than just meeting short-term regulatory requirements.

title: Indonesia's Carbon Economic Value: A Strategic Instrument for Industrial Transition
body: The implementation of Carbon Economic Value (NEK) in Indonesia is expected to increase energy efficiency, promote the adoption of green technology, and prepare industries for international climate policies. The policy will also have a significant impact on small and medium-sized enterprises (IKM) in the industrial supply chain, encouraging them to adopt low-carbon technologies and reduce their carbon footprint.

title: PLN Commits to Promoting Science and Technology for Renewable Energy Development in Indonesia
body: PT PLN (Persero) is committed to promoting the use of science and technology to increase the portion of new and renewable energy (EBT) in Indonesia, supporting energy self-sufficiency and national economic growth. The company is ready to collaborate with universities and research institutions to implement research results in accelerating the use of EBT in Indonesia.

title: Pertamina Develops Bioethanol from Aren Trees to Support National Energy Transition
body: PT Pertamina is preparing a strategic plan to develop renewable energy through the use of aren trees as a raw material for bioethanol, with a pilot project planned in several regions in Indonesia, aiming to produce 876,000 kiloliters of bioethanol per year. This initiative is expected to become a game-changer in the national energy transition and support the country's Net Zero Emission 2060 target.

title: Indonesia's Energy and Mineral Resources Sector: A Key Driver of National Development
body: As Indonesia celebrates its 80th anniversary, the energy and mineral resources sector reaffirms its strategic role in driving national development, with a focus on energy transition, national energy resilience, and sustainable exploration and production. The sector's future direction will be shaped by key decisions on new work areas, fiscal policy revisions, energy integration with industry, and large-scale energy infrastructure development.

title: Freeport Indonesia to ramp up concentrate exports ahead of ban
body: The firm has exported about 65% of the quota as of mid-August.

title: PT Pertamina Gas Commits to Developing Village-Based Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises
body: PT Pertamina Gas (Pertagas) has committed to developing village-based micro, small, and medium enterprises (UMKM) as part of its corporate social responsibility program, which has already benefited over 2,400 people directly and 7,500 people indirectly. The program aims to empower local communities to become economically independent and contribute to national economic growth.

title: MIND ID Holds MediaMIND 2025 Socialization at ITB, Fostering Innovation in Mining Sector
body: PT Mineral Industri Indonesia (MIND ID) held its first MediaMIND 2025 socialization event at the Institut Teknologi Bandung (ITB), attended by hundreds of students, public, and local media, aiming to provide in-depth information on the mining sector and its benefits. The event highlighted MIND ID's strategic initiatives, including optimizing natural resources while ensuring environmental and social sustainability, as seen in the post-mining program in Ombilin, which led to the site being listed as a UNESCO cultural heritage in 2019.

title: APNI's Training to Miners 2025 Forum Educates Nickel Industry Players on Regulations and Best Practices
body: The Training to Miners (TTM) 2025 forum, organized by the Indonesian Nickel Miners Association (APNI), aimed to educate nickel industry players on regulations, government policies, and current challenges in the mining sector. The three-day event featured speakers from the government, academia, and industry practitioners, providing a platform for discussion and knowledge sharing.

title: Indonesian Mining Industry Faces Challenges, Emphasizes Adaptation and Competency
body: The Indonesian mining industry is experiencing a significant slowdown due to global price dynamics and geopolitics, with nickel and coal production declining, while gold is showing a positive trend. The industry needs to adapt and improve its competency to remain competitive, with a focus on environmental, social, and governance (ESG) issues.

title: PT Timah's Conservation Efforts: Rehabilitating Over 1,000 Endangered Species
body: PT Timah, in collaboration with Alobi Foundation, has established a Wildlife Rescue Center in Pangkal Pinang, Bangka, which has successfully rehabilitated and released over 1,000 endangered species back into their natural habitats since 2018. This initiative is part of the company's environmental responsibility efforts, setting an example for other mining companies to follow.

title: PT Timah's New Smelter in Muntok, Bangka Belitung, Begins Operation
body: PT Timah's new smelter in Muntok, Bangka Belitung, with a production capacity of 40,000 tons of tin per year, has officially begun operation in January 2023 after a two-year delay due to the pandemic. The Ausmelt Furnace technology used in the smelter is more efficient and environmentally friendly, enabling the company to process low-grade tin concentrates and strengthening Indonesia's competitiveness in the global tin market.

title: Pertamina Hulu Energi Accelerates Oil and Gas Production for Indonesia's Energy Independence
body: PT Pertamina Hulu Energi (PHE) is speeding up oil and gas production to ensure Indonesia's energy independence, with a current contribution of 69% to national oil production and 37% to national gas production. PHE is implementing strategies to maintain baseline production and accelerate growth through exploration, new discoveries, and technology adoption, while ensuring compliance with ESG principles.

title: Pertamina Hulu Energi Accelerates Oil and Gas Exploration to Ensure Energy Security
body: PT Pertamina Hulu Energi (PHE) is accelerating oil and gas exploration to ensure energy security in Indonesia, with a significant contribution of 69% to domestic oil lifting and 37% to national gas sales. The company is focusing on high-impact exploration, Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR), and greenfield development to increase production, with several key projects underway.

title: PT Timah Supports Mapur Cultural Heritage through TJSL Program
body: PT Timah Tbk has launched a Tanggung Jawab Sosial dan Lingkungan (TJSL) program to preserve Mapur cultural heritage, building a traditional village, Kampung Adat Gebong Memarong, in Bangka Belitung, which has boosted the local economy and attracted tourists. The program has also provided training for local residents to become tour guides, with 2,000 tourists visiting the village every month.

title: MIND ID Develops Kalium Humat Product from Low-Calorie Coal, Boosting Agricultural Productivity by 30%
body: MIND ID, through its subsidiary PT Bukit Asam Tbk, has developed a kalium humat product from low-calorie coal, which can increase agricultural productivity by 30%. The product, resulting from a collaboration with Universitas Gadjah Mada, has a production capacity of 144 tons per year and is expected to support the government's national food self-sufficiency program.

title: Bangka Belitung to Host Indonesia's Largest Tin Smelter with $1.5-2 Billion Investment
body: The province of Bangka Belitung is set to host Indonesia's largest tin smelter with an investment of Rp1.5-2 trillion (approximately $1.5-2 billion) by PT Tong Fang, a Chinese investor, which is expected to produce 300 tons of high-value tin products per month. The smelter will create jobs for around 70% of the local workforce and is expected to start operating within a year.

title: ITB and IAFMI Sign MoU to Strengthen Collaboration in Oil and Gas Industry
body: Institut Teknologi Bandung (ITB) and Ikatan Ahli Fasilitas Produksi Minyak dan Gas Bumi Indonesia (IAFMI) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to enhance collaborative research and development in the oil and gas industry. The partnership aims to promote innovation, increase national capacity, and address global energy challenges.

title: Pertamina Drilling Successfully Completes Sembakung Deep-01 Exploration Well in Nunukan, Kalimantan Utara
body: Pertamina Drilling's Rig PDSI#43.3/AB1500-E successfully completed the Sembakung Deep-01 exploration well, reaching a depth of over 2,100 meters and discovering new gas reserves with low CO₂ content. The well's production test on August 4, 2025, showed a promising gas flow, marking a significant achievement for Pertamina Drilling and opening up new opportunities for energy exploration in Kalimantan.

title: PT Pertamina International Shipping Transplants 1000 Coral Fragments in Sabang to Support Marine Biodiversity
body: PT Pertamina International Shipping (PIS) has transplanted 1000 coral fragments in Sabang, Aceh, as part of its CSR program Marine BiodiverSEAty, aiming to support the creation of a healthy marine ecosystem. The program is expected to increase the productivity of the blue carbon ecosystem, with a potential carbon absorption of 0.4 tons per year.

title: PLN Nusantara Power's PIJAR GEMILANG Program Achieves Circular Economy and Sustainability
body: PLN Nusantara Power's PIJAR GEMILANG program has successfully transformed waste into valuable products, including organic fertilizers, animal feed, and hydroponic products, benefiting 55 people directly and 8,803 people indirectly, while also rehabilitating 13 hectares of critical land and reducing CO₂ emissions by 75,000 kg/year. The program has received national recognition, winning the TOP CSR 2025 Bintang 5 and Circular Economy Sustainability Award (CESA) 2025.

title: Pertamina Hulu Energi Revives Idle Well, Boosts National Oil Production
body: PT Pertamina Hulu Energi Offshore North West Java (PHE ONWJ) has successfully revived an idle well, LLE-5ST, which has been shut-in since 2012, and achieved a production rate of 2,635 barrels of oil per day (BOPD) with a water cut of 10%. The project was completed in 37 days, faster than the target of 46.2 days, and at a cost of USD 8.69 million, which is 64.66% of the approved budget.

title: APNI's Training to Miners 2025 Receives Positive Response from National Mining Industry
body: The Indonesian Nickel Miners Association (APNI) held its annual Training to Miners (TTM) 2025 event, which received a positive response from national mining industry players, providing updates on industry regulations and global trends. The event aimed to enhance the competitiveness of mining companies, addressing challenges such as regulatory pressures, decreasing nickel commodity prices, and increasing production costs.

title: PT Timah Tbk Struggles with Illegal Tin Mining, Calls for Regulatory Support
body: PT Timah Tbk, Indonesia's state-owned tin company, faces challenges in combating illegal tin mining, which has become a deeply ingrained culture in the country. The company is taking steps to address the issue, including tightening contracts with mining partners and introducing performance-based incentives, but acknowledges that regulatory support is crucial to reversing the trend.

title: PT Pertamina International EP Holds ESG Workshop to Align with Pertamina's Sustainability Path
body: PT Pertamina International EP (PIEP) held a two-day ESG Workshop to align its ESG strategy with Pertamina's path towards sustainability, featuring speakers from various sectors including Pertamina, Pertamina Hulu Energi, Medco Energi, Universitas Pertamina, and Fintech Solutions. The workshop aimed to strengthen PIEP's ESG strategy in supporting Pertamina's transition to new and renewable energy.

title: President Prabowo Appoints Brian Yuliarto as Head of Mineral Industry Agency
body: President Prabowo Subianto has officially inaugurated Brian Yuliarto as the Head of the Mineral Industry Agency, a new institution expected to play a crucial role in Indonesia's mineral downstreaming strategy. Yuliarto, a renowned academic with expertise in nanotechnology and quantum engineering, is tasked with leading the agency, which is seen as a game-changer for Indonesia's mineral industry.

title: PGN Ensures 100% Normal Gas Supply, Boosting Industrial Operations
body: PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk (PGN) has restored 100% normal gas supply, ensuring a stable and secure supply for industrial customers, and supporting national economic growth. The company achieved this through gas swap Natuna, optimization of gas and LNG supply, and close synergy with stakeholders.

title: Elnusa Strengthens Its Position in the Energy Sector with Aggressive Expansion Plans
body: PT Elnusa Tbk, a subsidiary of PT Pertamina Hulu Energi, is taking aggressive steps to strengthen its position in the energy sector, including increasing its credit facility from PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk from US$50 million to US$70 million and expanding its business lines in integrated upstream oil and gas services, energy distribution and logistics, and supporting services. The company's strategy is expected to drive growth and increase its competitiveness in the industry.

title: Indonesia sets up new mineral industry agency to oversee rare earths development
body: New mineral industry agency will also oversee radioactive materials.

title: Indonesian Mining Industry Embraces Sustainability and Technology
body: The Indonesian mining industry is adopting sustainable practices and advanced technologies to minimize its environmental impact, with companies like Freeport Indonesia and Grup MIND ID utilizing real-time monitoring and control rooms to reduce emissions and increase efficiency. The industry is also exploring recycling and reusing of mining waste, and is expected to play a crucial role in the country's transition to renewable energy.

title: Indonesian Anti-Corruption Agency Investigates Alleged Corruption in Pertamina's Oil and Gas Sector
body: The Indonesian Anti-Corruption Agency is investigating alleged corruption in Pertamina's oil and gas sector, involving eight key witnesses, including high-ranking officials from the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources and Pertamina. The case is estimated to have caused state losses of hundreds of trillions of rupiah.

title: Indonesia scraps coal pricing rules after pushback from buyers
body: Miners will now be allowed to sell below government-set benchmarks.

title: Pertamina's Energi Negeri 8.0 Inspires Thousands of Students Across Indonesia
body: Pertamina's Energi Negeri 8.0, a collaborative and inspirational movement, reached 19,152 students in 80 elementary schools across 28 cities in Indonesia, with 950 volunteers participating in the event. The program aims to inspire and educate students to become future leaders and promote ecological awareness.

title: Indonesia's Rare Earth Element Potential Remains Untapped
body: Indonesia has a significant potential for Rare Earth Element (REE) production, with an estimated 52,000 tons of REE in Bangka, but the country still lacks a special mining permit for REE and investment to develop the industry. Meanwhile, China dominates the global REE market, producing 83% of the world's total REE output.

title: Indonesia Establishes New Agency to Develop Rare Earth Minerals Industry
body: President Prabowo Subianto has formed the Badan Industri Mineral (BIM) to focus on developing the country's rare earth minerals industry, with 28 potential locations identified across Indonesia, and only 30% of them have been explored. The agency, led by Brian Yuliarto, aims to drive national economic growth and support the government's strategic agenda on energy security, defense, and natural resource-based industry development.

title: Riau Provincial Government and PT KPI Unit Dumai Discuss Buffer Zone Development in Dumai
body: The Riau Provincial Government and PT Kilang Pertamina Internasional (KPI) Unit Dumai have discussed the development of a buffer zone in Dumai, with a focus on the RT 02 area, which was initially considered affected but later deemed not affected after a Fire and Explosion Risk Assessment. The government and KPI have committed to prioritizing the safety of local residents and ensuring transparency in the development process.

title: Indonesia's RDMP Kilang Balikpapan Refinery to Start LPG Production in September
body: The Refinery Development Master Plan (RDMP) Kilang Balikpapan is set to start producing LPG from its LPG Treater facility in early September, with the Residual Fluid Catalytic Cracking (RFCC) unit targeted to start production in November. The refinery, a strategic national project, aims to increase Indonesia's oil refining capacity and produce more environmentally friendly fuel.

title: Freeport Indonesia to wrap up Gresik plant repairs by early September
body: Freeport expects to complete early next month repair work at its JV smelter in East Java.

title: Pertamina Supports 110 Young Innovators with IDR 3.7 Billion in Funding
body: Pertamina has awarded IDR 3.7 billion in funding to 110 young innovators through its PFmuda 2025 program, which aims to support social innovation and entrepreneurship among young people. The program has received 3,485 registrations and has selected 110 proposals that address various social issues, including poverty, education, and environmental sustainability.

title: Pertamina Launches Energy Education Program for 19,000 Students in 80 Schools Across Indonesia
body: PT Pertamina (Persero) has collaborated with the Pertamina Peduli Community to launch the Pertamina Energi Negeri (PEN) 8.0 program, educating over 19,000 students in 80 elementary schools across Indonesia. The program, themed 'Anak Hebat, Indonesia Kuat', aims to inspire young generations to contribute to the country's development and provide educational support, including school equipment and facilities.

title: Indonesian Students Support National Mining Downstreaming Program
body: Hundreds of students from nine universities in Bangka Belitung expressed their support for the national mining downstreaming program through the MediaMIND 2025 event, emphasizing the need for Indonesia to process its mineral resources domestically and export finished products to increase national revenue and strengthen the economy.

title: Pertamina Hulu Energi Accelerates Carbon Capture Utilization and Storage Project Development
body: PT Pertamina Hulu Energi (PHE) is pushing forward with its Carbon Capture Utilization and Storage (CCUS) project, with 13 active projects and a potential storage capacity of 7.3 Giga Tons. The company aims to develop an integrated CCUS business model, including carbon capture, transportation, compression, and storage, to support Indonesia's goal of reducing energy emissions by 69% by 2030.

title: Indonesian Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources Submits 18 Names for BPH Migas Committee
body: The Indonesian Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources has submitted 18 names to the President for the BPH Migas Committee, which plays a crucial role in regulating and supervising the downstream oil and gas sector. The DPR RI will conduct a fit and proper test to determine the chairman and members of the committee for the 2025-2029 period.

title: South32 sees limited risk of Indonesia replicating nickel success in alumina
body: South32 reported a 75% surge in full-year profit on Thursday, helped by strong performance at its alumina division and higher commodity prices.

title: Illegal Mining Remains a Major Obstacle to Nickel Industry's Decarbonization
body: The Indonesian Nickel Miners Association (APNI) has highlighted the persistent issue of illegal mining as a major hurdle to the implementation of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles in the nickel industry, with 11 community members currently facing legal action for protesting against illegal mining activities. APNI has called for a more realistic approach to decarbonization, emphasizing the need to address environmental and social impacts before pursuing carbon reduction goals.

title: PT Pertamina International Shipping's Sustainability Efforts Gain Recognition
body: PT Pertamina International Shipping (PIS) has been recognized for its significant role in promoting Indonesia's maritime industry globally, with a strong commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility. PIS has set a target to achieve net zero carbon emissions by 2050, 10 years ahead of the Indonesian government's target, and has already reduced carbon emissions by 51,090 tons CO₂e in 2024.

title: Pertamina Supports Used Cooking Oil Collection Program in Cilacap, Reduces Environmental Pollution
body: PT Pertamina, through its Refinery Unit IV Cilacap, has partnered with Bank Sampah Beo Asri to collect used cooking oil, with a monthly collection volume of 175 kg, generating an annual revenue of Rp12 million. The program aims to reduce environmental pollution and promote economic empowerment among local communities.

title: MIND ID Strengthens Strategic Role in Building Sustainable Industrial Ecosystem through Mineral Downstreaming
body: MIND ID, through PT Indonesia Asahan Aluminium (INALUM), is promoting the downstreaming of minerals, particularly bauxite, to increase the added value of domestic mineral resources, with the potential to increase the value of bauxite from $40 to $2,800. The company is also supporting the national decarbonization agenda by substituting High-Speed Diesel with Liquefied Natural Gas, reducing greenhouse gas emissions by 3,700 tCO2e per year.

title: Potential Buyers of Masela LNG Express Concerns Over Delivery Schedules
body: Potential buyers of LNG from the Masela block, operated by Inpex Masela Ltd, are expressing concerns over the reliability of delivery schedules, fearing that signed contracts may be changed mid-way. The Masela block is expected to produce 9.5 million tons of LNG per year, making it a crucial project for Indonesia's energy sector.

title: Thousands of Community Oil Wells in Sumatra Contribute to National Production
body: There are approximately 8,300 community oil wells in Sumatra, with 2,200 located in Jambi Province, contributing to national oil production. The government is currently conducting field verification to confirm the location, condition, and legal status of each well, with the aim of legalizing these wells and integrating them into the formal system.

title: Pertamina Launches 'Belida Musi Lestari' CSR Program to Support Sustainable Development in South Sumatra
body: Pertamina's 'Belida Musi Lestari' CSR program aims to develop an integrated and sustainable fishery area in Desa Sungai Gerong, Banyuasin, South Sumatra, and has already created 18 integrated fishery centers, benefiting 7 vulnerable groups. The program also promotes circular economy and has produced 40 nutrition-based products, supporting the local community's economic growth and environmental sustainability.

title: Elnusa's ETSA Launches Frontliner Marine Training Program to Enhance Professionalism and Safety
body: PT Elnusa Tbk's subsidiary, PT Elnusa Trans Samudera (ETSA), has launched the Frontliner Marine Training Program Batch III to equip its crew with world-class competencies and professionalism, aiming to support national energy production with a focus on safety and zero harm. The program is part of Elnusa's long-term investment in building superior human resources to maintain its competitiveness in the national and international energy industry.

title: Indonesia's Energy Ministry Appoints New Director General of Oil and Gas to Boost National Lifting Target
body: The Indonesian Energy Ministry has appointed Laode Sulaeman as the new Director General of Oil and Gas, tasking him to boost the country's national lifting target to 605,000 barrels by 2025, up from the current 600,000 barrels. The ministry aims to achieve this goal through improved coordination and integrity among stakeholders, as well as revisions to regulations hindering production growth.

title: Indonesia Sets Biodiesel Price Index at IDR 13,948 per Liter for September 2025
body: The Indonesian Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources has set the Biodiesel Price Index at IDR 13,948 per liter for September 2025, effective from September 1, 2025, based on the conversion of Crude Palm Oil to biodiesel at USD 85/MT. This move is part of the implementation of the Mandatory Biodiesel Program, aiming to support the country's energy transition.

title: PT Kilang Pertamina Internasional Supports Community Empowerment through Coconut Flour and Biscuit Training
body: PT Kilang Pertamina Internasional (KPI) Unit Kasim has organized a coconut flour and biscuit training program for the Kalifiti community, aiming to empower local women and improve their economic conditions. The program, which is part of KPI's corporate social responsibility initiatives, has the potential to create a positive impact on the local economy and environment.

title: PHE ONWJ Boosts Oil Production by 570 BOPD at Uniform Field
body: PT Pertamina Hulu Energi Offshore North West Java (PHE ONWJ) has successfully increased oil production by 570 barrels per day (BOPD) at the Uniform Field, exceeding the initial target of 276 BOPD. The achievement was made possible through the development of the UA-9 well, which was completed in just 24 days with a cost of USD 6.15 million, 60% below the approved budget.

title: Indonesia Ketapang Classic 2025: Fostering Cross-Border Collaboration in the Oil and Gas Industry
body: The Indonesia Ketapang Classic 2025 golf tournament brought together oil and gas industry players from Indonesia and Malaysia, promoting cross-border collaboration and networking in a relaxed atmosphere. The event, themed 'Nurturing Network', saw participants from both countries sharing experiences and exploring business opportunities, highlighting the importance of collaboration in the high-risk, high-investment oil and gas industry.

title: Indonesia's Nickel Industry Faces Trilemma in Implementing Environment, Social and Governance Standards
body: The Indonesian nickel industry is expected to face a trilemma of global demand, community price, and Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) standards, with companies such as PT Vale Indonesia and Ceria Corp already implementing ESG standards and remaining profitable. The industry is working towards a sustainable future, with a focus on research and development, human resource improvement, and collaboration between government, associations, and businesses to achieve a low-carbon footprint.

title: Indonesia Strengthens Inclusive and Sustainable Development Agenda Through Indonesia Energy & Engineering Series 2025
body: The Indonesia Energy & Engineering Series 2025, a multi-sector industry exhibition, aims to promote sustainability and industrial transformation, featuring over 2,000 participants from 42 countries and showcasing innovations in energy, infrastructure, and technology. The event supports the country's commitment to Net Zero Emission 2060 and highlights the importance of hilirisasi and efisiensi industri in achieving a green economy.

title: Presiden: Tertibkan Tambang Ilegal Tanpa Pandang Bulu
body: Sektor pertambangan menjadi andalan pendapatan negara," ujar Bahlil. Kementerian ESDM melalui Direktorat Jenderal Penegakan Hukum menegaskan akan menindaklanjuti instruksi Presiden tersebut.

title: Vale Indonesia Commits to Sustainable Mining Practices and Environmental Conservation
body: Vale Indonesia has made significant progress in its sustainability efforts, having reclaimed 3,800 hectares of land in Sulawesi and planted 5 million trees, while also reducing its reliance on fossil fuels through the use of renewable energy sources, including three hydroelectric power plants with a total capacity of 365 MW. The company's commitment to environmental conservation and sustainability is reflected in its reduction of greenhouse gas emissions by 838,000 tons of CO₂ equivalent from 2022 to 2024, exceeding its target of 711,000 tons.

title: Global Nickel Prices Remain Stable, Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate Sees Significant Increase
body: The Indonesia Nickel Price Index reported stable prices for most nickel products, with the exception of Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate, which saw a significant increase of $97 per metric ton to $12,883 per metric ton. The stability in nickel prices reflects a balance between global supply and demand, while the surge in MHP prices is driven by growing demand from the Asian battery industry for electric vehicles.

title: Pengeboran Sumur GGNB-S17 Menghasilkan Potensi Produksi Minyak dan Gas yang Signifikan
body: Pengeboran sumur GGNB-S17 yang dimulai pada 20 Agustus 2025 telah membuahkan hasil positif dengan potensi produksi sementara sebesar 776,16 barel minyak per hari dan 2,8 juta standar kaki kubik gas per hari. Uji produksi ini menunjukkan aliran hidrokarbon yang diperoleh secara natural dengan bean choke 64/64, menandakan prospek yang cerah untuk produksi minyak dan gas di lokasi ini.

title: Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia Releases Nickel Price Reference for September 2025
body: The Indonesian Nickel Miners Association (APNI) has announced a decrease in the Nickel Price Reference (HMA) for the period of September 2025, with a price of US$ 14.899,64 per dry metric ton. The association also provided detailed pricing for nickel ore with varying moisture content and nickel grades, ranging from US$ 26.34 to US$ 43.80 per wet metric ton.

title: Indonesian Nickel Mining Industry Faces Challenges with B40 Implementation and Decreasing Nickel Prices
body: The Indonesian nickel mining industry is experiencing significant challenges due to the implementation of B40, with production costs increasing by 3-5% and nickel prices reaching a 10-year low of $15,000 per metric ton. The Indonesian Nickel Miners Association (APNI) is calling for a comprehensive evaluation of the B40 policy, citing concerns over supply chain disruptions, decreased profit margins, and reduced tax revenues.

title: PT Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama announces the issuance of its third rupiah conventional bond, Obligasi III BUMA Tahun 2025, with a principal value of up to Rp1.4 trillion
body: PT Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama has announced the issuance of its third rupiah conventional bond, Obligasi III BUMA Tahun 2025, with a principal value of up to Rp1.4 trillion to be used for debt repayment, capital expenditure, and working capital. The bond issuance is part of the company's strategy to diversify its funding sources, reduce risks, and strengthen its financial resilience to support its long-term growth in the mining sector.

title: Kementerian ESDM Allocates Rp8.117 Trillion for Energy Infrastructure Development and Mining Sector Enhancement in 2025
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources has allocated Rp8.117 trillion for energy infrastructure development, including Rp2.9 trillion for gas network expansion and Rp460 billion for solar power plant construction, aiming to enhance energy accessibility and security. The budget also covers initiatives such as education and training programs, with Rp165.6 billion allocated for vocational training in the energy and mining sector, as well as mitigation and disaster management efforts.

title: Indonesia's Energy Policy Requires Long-Term Planning to Avoid Crisis and Ensure Sustainability
body:
Indonesia's energy policy has been criticized for being driven by political motives rather than careful calculation, leading to inconsistent decisions that can have long-term negative impacts on the economy and environment. The government must prioritize data-driven, sustainable, and consistent policies to ensure a stable energy supply, protect the environment, and maintain the country's competitiveness.
}

title: Indonesia’s illegal mining crackdown facing structural hurdles, BMI says
body: Indonesia’s plans to seize more than 1,000 illegal mining sites starting this month are unlikely to deliver "meaningful environmental gains", the Fitch Solutions company says.

title: Indonesia Aims to Dominate Global Nickel Industry with Strategic Management and Increased Production
body: Indonesia has the potential to become a major player in the global nickel industry, with over 700 million tons of nickel reserves and 54 smelter facilities, and is expected to produce 414,000 tons of nickel this year. However, the industry faces challenges such as reliance on imports and high production costs, and the government is urged to provide strategic solutions to maintain competitive pricing and support the growth of the domestic industry.

title: Indonesian Government Evaluates B40 Biodiesel Program Implementation with Mining Industry Stakeholders
body: The Indonesian government, through the Directorate General of New, Renewable, and Energy Conservation, held a discussion on the implementation of the 40% biodiesel program in the industrial sector, which has increased production costs in the nickel mining sector by 3-5%. The evaluation aims to find solutions to ensure the program's sustainability, considering factors such as global commodity prices and the potential impact of the upcoming B50 program.

title: Kilang Pertamina Internasional Exceeds Operational Targets in First Semester 2025
body: Kilang Pertamina Internasional (KPI) has surpassed its operational targets for the first semester of 2025, processing approximately 159 million barrels of crude oil and achieving an 84% yield of valuable products. The company has also reduced its cumulative emissions by 205,000 tons of CO2 equivalent, exceeding its initial target of 157,000 tons, and has improved its energy efficiency with an Energy Intensity Index (EII) of 105, lower than its target of 107.

title: Anglo-Peabody mine tussle leaves Indonesian mining firm seeking new coal assets
body: PT Buma Internasional is still on the hunt for coal assets, as uncertainty lingers about its planned purchase of a stake in the Dawson project.

title: Sulawesi Tenggara Students Attend Leadership Training, Learn About Region's Nickel Mining Potential
body: A group of students from Sulawesi Tenggara attended a leadership training in Bogor, where they learned about their region's potential as a major nickel producer, with the area being the largest nickel producer in Indonesia and the world. The students emphasized the importance of improving local human resources to manage the region's natural wealth, including nickel, which is a key component in electric vehicle batteries.

title: PT Bukit Asam's Desa Impian Program Empowers Local Economy Through 'Local Heroes' Approach
body: PT Bukit Asam's Desa Impian program has successfully empowered local economies by transforming non-productive land into integrated agricultural centers, with 80 beneficiaries and a collective annual turnover of Rp3.05 billion. The program has also reduced illegal mining practices, created new job opportunities, and promoted eco-friendly technologies, such as solar-powered irrigation systems, resulting in a significant reduction of 2.28 tons of CO₂ emissions per year.

title: Menteri Lingkungan Hidup praises PT Vale Indonesia's progressive and sustainable environmental investment, citing its rehabilitation efforts and 3R waste management principles.
body: PT Vale Indonesia has reclaimed 3,800 hectares of land in Sulawesi, planted over 5 million trees, and operated three hydroelectric power plants with a total capacity of 365 MW, minimizing its reliance on fossil fuels. The company has also successfully utilized 100% of its non-B3 waste, demonstrating its commitment to environmental sustainability and responsible mining practices.

title: Indonesia Emphasizes Collaboration and Regional Strategy to Boost Electric Vehicle Ecosystem in Southeast Asia
body: The 2nd Automotive Electrical Indonesia Summit highlighted the importance of collaboration, regional strategy, and innovation in boosting Indonesia's electric vehicle ecosystem, with experts emphasizing the need for standardized policies and international cooperation to support the growth of the industry. Indonesia is poised to become a major player in the regional electric vehicle market, with its large market size and abundant nickel resources, but requires strategic investments and sustainable business models to achieve this goal.

title: Nickel Industries Ltd. Expands into Class 1 Nickel Production to Support Electric Vehicle Battery Development
body: Nickel Industries Ltd. has begun operating a project to produce class 1 nickel, a key component in electric vehicle batteries, with plans to integrate it with the local steel and metal industry and achieve commercial production by early 2026. The company's strategy aims to strengthen Indonesia's position in the global electric vehicle supply chain and support the world's energy transition efforts.

title: Sumur Migas Tua Bisa Disulap Menjadi Sumber Listrik Ramah Lingkungan Melalui Teknologi Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Panas Bumi
body: Pakar migas dan panas bumi, Rudi Rubiandini, menyatakan bahwa sumur-sumur tua yang masih menyimpan panas bumi bisa disulap menjadi sumber listrik ramah lingkungan lewat teknologi Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Panas Bumi (PLTP) dengan konsep geothermal co-production. Indonesia dan India menjajaki peluang kerja sama untuk mengadaptasi teknologi ini, dengan potensi besar untuk mengkonversi ribuan sumur migas tua menjadi sumber energi hijau.

title: BPMA Proposes New Initiatives for 2026 to Boost National Oil and Gas Development and Support Energy Transition
body: The Badan Pengelola Migas Aceh (BPMA) has proposed new initiatives for 2026, including a Rp3.9 billion allocation for exploration development in the North Sumatra Basin and Sibolga Basin, and a Rp4.5 billion allocation for monitoring and evaluating Carbon Capture Storage (CCS) and Carbon Capture Utilization and Storage (CCUS) in Aceh. These initiatives aim to accelerate national oil and gas development, support the energy transition agenda, and reduce carbon emissions in line with Indonesia's net zero emission target by 2060.

title: Indonesia’s Merdeka says its gold subsidiary will launch $300M IPO
body: Its flagship mine in Pani Mountain in Sulawesi is estimated to have 7 million ounces of gold resources.

title: Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia emphasizes the importance of enforcing Harga Patokan Mineral in domestic nickel ore transactions to ensure compliance with regulations
body: The Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia (APNI) has stressed the need for strict monitoring of Harga Patokan Mineral (HPM) implementation in domestic nickel ore sales, despite existing regulations since 2020, to prevent irregular transactions. APNI aims to enhance its members' understanding of marketing strategies and industry governance to support the sustainability of Indonesia's nickel sector amidst global competition.

title: Mubadala Energy Aims to Repeat Success in Aceh, Indonesia, Following Significant Gas Discoveries in the Andaman Region
body: Mubadala Energy, a UAE-based energy company, is seeking to replicate its success in the Andaman region, where it discovered 8 trillion cubic feet of gas-in-place, in Aceh, Indonesia, with the potential to turn the region into a new epicenter for gas production. The company's plans, supported by the UAE Ambassador to Indonesia, Abdulla Salem Al Dhaheri, could lead to significant investments and the development of new gas fields in Aceh, boosting the region's energy production and revenue.

title: Warga Binaan Lapas Nusakambangan Menghasilkan Produk Konstruksi dari Limbah Batu Bara dengan Nilai Ekonomi
body: Warga binaan Lapas Nusakambangan telah menghasilkan produk konstruksi seperti batako, paving block, roaster, dan buis beton dari limbah batu bara dengan kapasitas produksi hingga 2 juta paving block dan 1 juta batako per tahun, berpotensi menghasilkan omzet hingga Rp5,4 miliar per tahun. Program ini merupakan kolaborasi antara Kementerian Imigrasi dan Pemasyarakatan dengan PT PLN dan telah melibatkan 30 warga binaan yang telah aktif dan terampil memproduksi olahan limbah batu bara.

title: Nickel shortage, higher costs pinch Indonesian producers
body: Permitting issues are a key reason for the ore scarcity.

title: PT Bintang Delapan Mineral Reklamasi Lahan Pascatambang Seluas 1.337 Hektare di Morowali
body: PT Bintang Delapan Mineral (BDM) telah melakukan reklamasi lahan pascatambang seluas 1.337 hektare di wilayah izin usaha pertambangan (IUP) Morowali, Sulawesi Tengah, sejak 2010 hingga 2025, dengan tingkat kelangsungan hidup tanaman mencapai 75%-80%. Reklamasi ini dilakukan sebagai bentuk tanggung jawab perusahaan dalam menjaga keseimbangan lingkungan pascapenambangan serta pemulihan fungsi ekologi tanah, dan telah direalisasikan pada 950 ha lahan dengan penanaman sekitar 625 bibit per ha.

title: ANTAM's Profitability Surges 240% in the First Semester of 2025, Driven by Strong Gold and Nickel Performance
body: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) reported a 240% increase in profitability in the first semester of 2025, driven by strong performance in gold and nickel, with gold sales rising 163% to Rp49.54 trillion. The company's EBITDA also increased significantly by 194% to Rp7.11 trillion, reflecting the implementation of its strategy to strengthen its domestic customer base and effective business strategies.

title: Pertamina Develops Green Hydrogen Pilot Plant in Ulubelu, Lampung, to Support Indonesia's Energy Transition and Reduce Carbon Emissions
body: Pertamina has invested $3 million in the development of a Green Hydrogen Pilot Plant in Ulubelu, Lampung, which is expected to create new job opportunities, reduce carbon emissions, and support Indonesia's energy transition goals. The project is part of Pertamina's strategy to develop a green hydrogen ecosystem, with plans to expand to other geothermal working areas and explore the production of green ammonia and green methanol.

title: ANTAM Catat Lonjakan Laba di Semester I 2025
body: Pertumbuhan laba terutama ditopang oleh kontribusi signifikan dari segmen nikel serta logam mulia dan pemurnian. Dari sisi operasional, penjualan komoditas nikel (feronikel dan bijih nikel) naik 125% menjadi Rp7,87 triliun dibandingkan Rp3,50 triliun pada 1H24.

title: ITMG Optimistis Penuhi Target 2025
body: Meski membukukan kinerja baik di sisi produksi dan penjualan, pendapatan Perusahaan di sepanjang semester pertama 2025 tercatat sebesar $919 juta, atau terkoreksi sebesar 12%, akibat penurunan harga jual rata-rata batubara (ASP) sebesar 19%. Pada pilar bisnis energi terbarukan, khususnya energi berbasis surya, kapasitas terkontrak menunjukkan pertumbuhan signifikan dalam kurun empat tahun.

title: Indonesia cites lack of forestry permits in land seizures from nickel miners
body: President Prabowo Subianto said last week that more than 1,000 illegal mining operations were identified.

title: Nickel price gains after Indonesia seizes part of giant mine
body: A government task force took control on Thursday of about 148 hectares of the operation owned by PT Weda Bay Nickel.

title: Indonesia’s United Tractors seeks expansion with gold miner acquisition
body: Indonesian heavy machinery distributor PT United Tractors is acquiring a 100% stake in PT Arafura Surya Alam.

title: Gold miner seeks $284 million in largest Indonesia IPO this year
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources will offer 1.62 billion shares, or a 10% stake.

title: Antam Posts 240% Surge in 1H 2025 Net Profit, Nickel Segment Drives Record Sales and ESG Milestones
body: PT Antam’s first‑half 2025 net profit jumped 240% to Rp5.14 trillion, largely thanks to a nickel boom that delivered Rp3.53 trillion in profit, 125% sales growth to Rp7.87 trillion, and 9.10 Mt of ore production, while gold sales rose 163% to Rp49.54 trillion. The company also advanced its ESG agenda with a 2030 decarbonization roadmap, 75% land rehabilitation, and a new alumina smelter project in Mempawah, positioning Antam as a leading Indonesian mining player.

title: Indonesia Nickel HPM Climbs to $15,000.33/dmt in September 2025
body: Indonesia's Association of Nickel Miners (APNI) reported that the benchmark price for nickel (HPM) rose to US$15,000.33 per dry metric ton in the second September 2025 period, up from US$14,899.64 in the first period, while FOB prices for 1.60% Ni ore ranged from US$28.56 to US$26.52 per wet metric ton depending on moisture content. The increase reflects a positive global market trend and is expected to support investment climate, fairness, and transparency in the domestic nickel industry.

title: Merdeka Gold set for debut after Indonesia’s largest IPO of year
body: Merdeka raised 4.66 trillion rupiah ($281 million) by selling a 10% stake in the IPO.

title: PT Timah Tbk Reports 32% Drop in Tin Ore Production, Seeks DPR Support to Overcome Regulatory Hurdles
body: During a Rapat Dengar Pendapat on 22 September 2025, PT Timah Tbk disclosed a 32% YoY fall in tin ore production to 6,997 t Sn and a 19% decline in revenue to Rp4.22 trillion, while average selling price rose 8% to USD 32,816 per metric ton. The company outlined plans to open new mines in Beriga, Rias and Laut Oliver, expand its fleet of 60 production barges, launch a CSR‑driven cooperative program, and requested the DPR VI to expedite regulations for illegal‑mining reclamation, downstream processing, and zoning adjustments to restore output.

title: Freeport mine setback risks fraying relations with Indonesia
body: Grasberg has long been a flashpoint as Jakarta tries to gain a greater say over its resources.

title: Indonesia halts Grasberg operations to search for trapped workers
body: Two workers have died and five remain missing following a large mudflow earlier this month.

title: Indonesia’s Coal Industry Remains Strategic Pillar Amid Production Peak and Clean‑Energy Transition Plans
body: Indonesia’s coal production peaked at 836 Mt in 2024, with a 2025 target of 739 Mt and 68 % realized so far, while the sector contributes roughly Rp250 trillion to national revenue, including PNBP and taxes. The government is boosting clean‑energy use and downstream value‑addition—projecting smelter consumption to rise from 5 Mt to over 60 Mt and developing DME, methanol, and other coal‑derived products to support a more sustainable, low‑carbon coal strategy.

title: APNI Releases Indonesia Nickel Price Index: Stable Prices, MHP Declines
body: APNI’s latest Indonesia Nickel Price Index shows most nickel products remain stable, with 1.2% ore at US$23/mt and 1.6% ore at US$52.15/mt, while nickel pig iron and high‑grade matte prices are unchanged; however, the key battery‑grade MHP fell by US$7/mt to US$13,145/mt, signalling a potential dip in global battery raw‑material demand amid the EV boom.

title: Indonesia Secures 64% of Global Nickel Production, Calls for Consistent Regulation to Sustain Downstream Growth
body: Indonesia now controls about 64% of worldwide nickel output, with 424 mining firms and 163 processing plants—including 55 active in pyro‑metallurgy and HPAL—according to APNI Secretary General Meidy Katrin Lengkey at the ICMMS 2025 summit. She urged the government to maintain stable, investor‑friendly regulations to support downstream sectors such as stainless steel and battery manufacturing, warning that sudden policy shifts could hinder investment and national revenue.

title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources raises IDR 4.66 trillion in IPO to fund its Pani Gold Project
body: Gold – PT Merdeka Gold Resources issued 1.62 billion new shares (10% of capital) at Rp2,880 each, raising IDR 4.66 trillion for working capital, loan repayment and development of the Pani Gold Project, which holds an estimated 7 million ounces of gold and targets a peak output of 500,000 ounces per year with first production slated for Q1 2026. The IPO was fully subscribed, reflecting strong market confidence in the company’s growth prospects.

title: Freeport-McMoRan still in talks with Indonesia over Grasberg mine rights
body: PT Freeport Indonesia is 51% owned by Indonesia's government but operated by Freeport.

title: Freeport will divest 12% of local arm to Indonesia, CNBC says
body: The divestment is part of an agreement to extend the company’s license to operate the Grasberg mine.

title: Indonesia’s Merdeka starts mining at Pani gold project
body: The company aims to produce 140,000 ounces of gold annually.

title: Freeport Indonesia says search for five trapped Grasberg workers still ongoing
body: The incident has caused a jump in global copper prices.

title: Indonesia expects deal soon with Freeport-McMoRan on divestment plan
body: Last week, Freeport declared force majeure at Grasberg after torrential mudslides that killed two workers.

title: Indonesia Nickel Prices Rise in Early October 2025, APNI Calls for Market‑Reflective Adjustments
body: The price of nickel in the first half of October 2025 climbed to US$15,101.67 per dmt, up from US$15,000.33 in the second half of September, according to APNI’s release. APNI praised the transparency of the calculation formula but urged the government to adjust the benchmark to better reflect market realities, especially for low‑grade domestic miners, while highlighting price variations across grades and moisture contents.

title: Merdeka Battery Materials Sees 78% YoY Surge in Nickel Ore Production Despite 32% Revenue Drop
body: In the first half of 2025, Merdeka Battery’s nickel ore output jumped 78% to 6.9 Mt wmt, driven by 45% growth in limonite and 189% in saprolite, while its nickel pig iron production fell 23% to 33,045 t due to RKEF smelter maintenance, yet cash costs dropped below $10k/ton. The company also sold 9,465 t of mixed hydroxide precipitate via HPAL Train A, advanced a 90,000 t/yr HPAL plant to 29% completion, and is building two feed preparation plants and a slurry pipeline to support future supply chain optimization, with EBITDA at $77 M despite a 8% YoY decline.

title: Column: Tin breaks higher as Indonesia cracks down on illegal miners
body: The tin market is once again bubbling on supply chain trouble, this time in Indonesia.

title: Indonesia hands over six seized tin smelters to state miner
body: Among the assets seized was PT Refined Bangka Tin, once one of the largest private players in the sector.

title: Indonesia Issues New Mining Regulation to Expand Access for SMEs, Cooperatives, and Religious Organizations
body: The government issued PP 39/2025, a second amendment to PP 96/2021, to accelerate inclusion of SMEs, cooperatives, and religious organizations in mining and downstream activities, allowing priority allocation of up to 2,500 ha for SMEs and 25,000 ha for larger entities. The regulation also permits use of by‑product radioactive minerals as new energy sources, prioritizes domestic demand and value‑added processing, and revises license renewal terms to extend up to 10 years for integrated operations, with a one‑year grace period for expired permits.

title: Central Omega Resources Reports Record Production and Profit Surge in H1 2025
body: PT Central Omega Resources Tbk reported a 140% jump in nickel ore production to 1.73 Mt and a 159% rise in sales to 1.83 Mt in the first half of 2025, driving net profit to Rp310.3 bn and EBITDA to Rp481.4 bn. The company attributes the surge to the full resumption of mining operations under a new 2024 RKAB, remains optimistic for the rest of 2025 amid stable global nickel prices, but cautions about potential US tariff uncertainties while pursuing new reserves and operational efficiencies.

title: LiuGong Indonesia Announces $317 Million Heavy‑Equipment Plant in Karawang, Targeting 5,000 Units Annually by 2030
body: LiuGong Indonesia has signed a memorandum of understanding to build a $317 million heavy‑equipment manufacturing facility in Karawang Barat, with operations slated to begin in 2026 and a projected annual output of 5,000 units by 2030, supported by advanced AGV and MES technologies. The plant will boost Indonesia’s heavy‑equipment industry, aim for a five‑year TKDN certification, and generate up to US$40 million in foreign‑exchange exports to Southeast Asia, Australia and North America.

title: PT Petrosea Tbk Signs $26.2M EPC Agreement with Pakistan's Reko Diq Mining Company
body: PT Petrosea Tbk has signed a Limited Notice to Proceed with its wholly‑owned subsidiary Petrosea Solutions Pakistan for a US$26.2 million EPC contract to build foundations and infrastructure for the Reko Diq gold and copper mine in Pakistan, with a 10‑month completion timeline. The deal marks the company’s expansion of its EPC services and client base beyond Indonesia, reinforcing its diversified growth strategy.

title: Supply problems may force Freeport Indonesia to halt Manyar smelter
body: The $3.7 billion Manyar smelter only resumed operations in May after a fire broke out in October last year.

title: Indonesian tin miner eyes mining asset in Canada
body: Arsari Tambang says it will take advantage of an economic partnership deal signed with Canada last month to invest in a mining asset there.

title: Indonesia Launches Minerba Convex 2025, Emphasizing Sustainable Mining, Digitalization, and Local IUP Redistribution
body: The inaugural Minerba Convex 2025 forum in Jakarta, attended by over 6,000 participants, highlighted Indonesia’s push for sustainable mining through digital integration with the new Minerba One app, a $40 billion nickel export surge, and a PNBP contribution of Rp654 trillion from 2019‑2024. The event also underscored the government's commitment to redistribute mining permits to local UMKM and BUMD, suspend 190 IUPs pending reclamation guarantees, and invest Rp24 trillion in community development via the PPM program.

title: Supreme Energy inaugurates first production well for 80 MW Muara Laboh Unit 2 geothermal plant in Solok Selatan, Sumatra Barat
body: Supreme Energy (joint venture with Sumitomo and INPEX) inaugurated the first production well of the 80 MW Muara Laboh Unit 2 geothermal power plant in Solok Selatan, Sumatra Barat, with the governor noting a Rp30 billion per‑year profit‑sharing deal and 85 % local workforce. The plant, expected to be operational by end‑2027 under a PPA with PLN, will supply electricity to roughly 435,000 households, boost the renewable‑energy mix and avoid about 460,000 t of CO₂ emissions annually.

title: Harita Nickel posts Rp22.40 trillion Q3 2025 revenue, advances IRMA audit and expands 40 MW solar and new smelter capacity
body: Harita Nickel reported Q3 2025 revenue of Rp22.40 trillion and is the first Indonesian miner undergoing a full IRMA audit that reviews more than 30,000 employees and contractors. The company also progressed its 40 MWp solar installation on Obi Island to 38% completion and its third Rotary Kiln Electric Furnace (RKEF‑3) to 44% of phase 3 (91% of phase 2), targeting an annual production capacity of 185,000 tonnes of nickel in ferronickel.

title: Gold: PT Bumi Resources Minerals posts 69% revenue jump and 25% production rise in 9M 2025 while scaling CIL capacity and preparing underground mine.
body: PT Bumi Resources Minerals (BRMS) posted 9M 2025 revenue of $183 million (+69%), operating profit $69 million (+144%) and net profit $37 million (+129%) while gold output rose 25% to 56,552 oz (up from 45,366 oz) and average gold price increased 34% to $3,156/oz. The company is expanding CIL capacity from 500 t/d to 2,000 t/d (first plant) and operating a second CIL at 4,500 t/d, targeting a combined 6,000 t/d by late‑2026, advancing push‑back work at River Reef (Q4 2025‑Q1 2026) and underground mine development with a 350 m decline, aiming for 68,000‑71,000 oz gold in 2025 and higher production from 3.5‑4.9 g/t ore from mid‑2027.

title: Indonesia's Energy Ministry Backs Amman Mineral's 480,000 Dry Metric Ton Copper Concentrate Exports
body: Indonesia's energy ministry has backed Amman Mineral Internasional to export 480,000 dry metric tons of copper concentrate for six months from October 31, allowing mining operations to continue and preventing concentrate storage facilities from exceeding capacity. This decision follows temporary operational halts at Amman's smelter in July and August due to damage, with repairs projected to finish in the first half of 2026, though Amman still needs to secure an export permit from the trade ministry.

title: Freeport Indonesia's Grasberg Copper and Gold Mine Receives Improvement Recommendations Following Mud Flow Investigation, Grasberg Block Cave Restart Projected for 2026
body: Freeport Indonesia has concluded its investigation into the fatal September 8 mud flow at its Grasberg copper and gold mine complex, which killed seven workers and involved 800,000 metric tons of wet material, receiving improvement recommendations from the government. Parent Freeport-McMoRan reported that Big Gossan and Deep Mill Level Zone mines restarted in late October, with a phased restart and ramp-up of the Grasberg Block Cave (representing 70% of Freeport Indonesia’s estimated copper and gold output through 2029) expected in 2026.

title: Indonesia Halts New Nickel Plant Permits for Intermediate Products to Boost Downstream Processing
body: Indonesia, the world's largest nickel producer accounting for approximately 60% of global supply, has ceased approving new industrial permits for nickel plants producing intermediate products such as nickel pig iron, matte, and mixed hydroxide precipitate, unless there are plans for further processing. This regulatory decision, a renewed push to move further up the value chain, is expected to force new entrants to invest in additional downstream capacity, potentially leading to project delays and cancellations, with Citigroup Inc. analysts noting it addresses Indonesia's persistent oversupply and might affect plants completing after 2027.

title: Indonesia to Implement 7.5%-15% Gold Export Tax Next Year
body: Indonesia will implement gold export taxes of 7.5% to 15% next year, with lower rates for processed goods and higher rates for gold dore, particularly when global prices are at or above $3,200 per troy ounce. This policy, currently being finalized, aims to encourage domestic processing and capture windfall profits, as Indonesia's gold exports hit $1.64 billion for the first nine months of 2025, up from $1.1 billion last year, with spot gold trading above $4,000 per ounce.

title: Indonesia Nickel Plant Cuts Production Due to Full Tailings Site
body: PT QMB New Energy Materials Co. Ltd., a majority Chinese-owned nickel and cobalt producer at Indonesia’s Morawali Industrial Park, is cutting production for at least two weeks as its tailings site is nearly full, with paperwork for a new location still processing. This highlights the industry's growing waste management challenge, particularly concerning the high waste volumes from the HPAL method, which faces increased local scrutiny, sustainability questions in the tropical archipelago, and a history of incidents including a deadly landslide at QMB's site earlier this year.

title: Freeport Indonesia Cuts Grasberg Copper and Gold Production Plans Following Fatal Accident
body: Freeport Indonesia cut its 2026 production plans for the Grasberg mine, the world's second-largest copper and largest gold mine, following a fatal September accident and mud flow at its Grasberg Block Cave (GBC) operation. The company now projects 2026 output of 478,000 metric tons of copper cathode and 26 tons of gold (down from ~700,000 tons copper and ~45 tons gold), with GBC targeting Q1 2026 operation and full recovery in 2027, while expecting $8.3 billion in sales next year and a 18% revenue decline in 2025 despite 30% lower copper and 50% lower gold sales volumes due to higher prices.
